sources.title: HugWBC: A Unified and General Humanoid Whole-Body Controller for Fine-Grained Locomotion
sources.verification: Official project text and official repository README read; no full Q1 implementation imported.
sources.finding: Upper-body intervention and locomotion objectives can be trained together with explicit commands; robot morphology and control still require adaptation.
sources.q1_boundary: RF15 tests a bounded lower residual under fixed0.5 arm composition and some pure-base resets, not the full HugWBC command space or curriculum.

sources.title: HOMIE: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Isomorphic Exoskeleton Cockpit
sources.verification: Official project and repository README read.
sources.finding: Separate lower-body balance/locomotion learning and upper-body motion objectives are relevant to our observed coupling.
sources.q1_boundary: This does not establish that Q1 residual PPO has sufficient exploration, rewards, or correction radius.

sources.title: ExBody2: Advanced Expressive Humanoid Whole-Body Control
sources.verification: Official project text, paper HTML and earlier ExBody official repository README read.
sources.finding: Expressive tracking combines reference motion and task-aware full-body dynamics; data selection and learning distribution matter.
sources.q1_boundary: RF15 retains original300/30 and does not claim a full-body generalist or real hardware transfer. If residuals fail, separately targeting locomotion velocity and upper pose is a candidate, not an established fix.

sources.title: BeyondMimic: From Motion Tracking to Versatile Humanoid Control
sources.verification: Official repository README and project search result read; no full Q1 port performed.
sources.finding: A reliable physical tracking implementation and transparent failure evaluation should precede claims of broad transfer.
sources.q1_boundary: Using RSL-RL PPO alone does not reproduce BeyondMimic or repair RF14's still-unisolated degradation.

conclusions: The current best supported Q1 arm gain comes from static composition; learned gait compensation needs a separate paired comparison.
Frozen base plus bounded residual limits the trainable surface but does not guarantee gait preservation.
The07:00 optimization and09:00 delivery deadlines remain unchanged. Do not modify the live RF15 frozen source.
